required_corrections.finding: Participant binding is mapped as an Operator Declaration, but Current R2552 and proposed R2804 describe one typed instance-binding construct and their semantics substantially overlap.
required_corrections.smallest_resolution: Use one canonical Construct Declaration for instance binding, with one CFEL/Construct Subject grounded in the existing Bind instance variables / Bind selected instances concept. Retain R2552 as the supplemental Rule for cardinality, identity, Property/bearer, and aggregate constraints, or merge its unique constraints into the canonical source. Merge R2804 syntax details ($x[<Kind>, (conditions)], $<Kind>, and variable scope) into that owner. Do not keep two binding owners or create two near-synonym Construct subjects.

required_corrections.finding: Approved CFEL/Relation//NAME is absent. The map instead gives both forward and reverse named-relation direction spellings a generic CFEL/Operator//Relation Direction Subject.
required_corrections.smallest_resolution: Reconcile the existing generic relation-name syntax with the exact approved Relation//NAME Subject. Keep directionality and concrete Relation Declaration semantics distinct; do not invent a Relation entity or Operator descriptor.

required_corrections.finding: The map conflates relation alias := (HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE) with qualified-Subject selection := under the same Relation//HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE owner.
required_corrections.smallest_resolution: Keep HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE := under its Relation Declaration. Reclassify qualified Subject := as a distinct selection syntax owner using the source-backed property-value-selection concept in R2816; do not treat it as the graph Relation itself.

required_corrections.finding: Current R2616 still declares a CFEL Operator descriptor and says Operator//Name identifies descriptors, contrary to the settled no-CFEL-Operator-entity-descriptor decision. The four Forms do not by themselves retire that Current owner.
required_corrections.smallest_resolution: Treat the catalogue as proposed only until the R2616 descriptor retirement and consumers are reconciled; keep ordinary Actor/Operator separate.

required_corrections.finding: The exact-one-owner preview R2278 remains held with active Subject Entity, and the ownership-impact packet records unresolved R2732/R2469 relation/form integration.
required_corrections.smallest_resolution: Do not claim these Form previews establish effective owner admission. Reconcile the existing owner/IS_DECLARED_BY/HAS_ACTIVE_SUBJECT gates in their owning packet before adoption.

rows_requiring_no_new_item.owner: single Conditional Construct Declaration; ELSE behavior remains a semantic gate
same named Relation direction family; exact Relation//NAME owner must be reconciled
HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE Relation syntax; | remains contextual alternative separator

bottom_line: The four generic Form bodies are coherent proposal templates, and most of the 49 rows have one plausible owner. Do not adopt the catalogue as ready: fix binding ownership, include the exact approved Relation//NAME Subject, separate the two := contexts, and keep Current owner/cutover gates visible.
